lines.text: Every morning, a giant walked into the valley.
Over nine feet tall. Covered in bronze.
I defy the ranks of Israel this day! Give me a man to fight!
Then a shepherd boy showed up, bringing bread for his brothers.
Who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?
The LORD, who delivered me from the claws of the lion and the bear, will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine.
No armor. Just a sling, and five smooth stones.
Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?
You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD of Hosts!
And he fell facedown on the ground.
Not by sword or spear. By God.
So what giant are you facing today?
